summary: A light (#fcfcfc) careers/team section. Top-left: a tiny tracked uppercase eyebrow "OUR STUDIO · THE PEOPLE" with a violet dot, then a two-line large sans headline, "Meet the people" in near-black and "behind the work." in soft lavender (#a497dc-ish), ~60px type. Top-right: a two-line grey paragraph and a green-dot uppercase tag "04 PEOPLE, ONE TEAM". Across the middle a thin grey wire runs from x≈247 to x≈1310 and sags in a shallow curve (ends y≈303, middle y≈327). It has four small grey round pins at x≈282/613/944/1275. From each pin a hairline string drops to a grey ring-clip at the top centre of a hanging card. The four cards (~300×415, radius ~22, light grey #f2f2f2 with a soft drop shadow) each hang at a slight rest tilt (about −2°, +1°, −1°, +1.5°) and at staggered heights: card tops ≈362, 445, 402, 440. Each front has a small "PEOPLE · STUDIO" label and "#0n" number, a rounded square 3D-character avatar render on a tinted backdrop (pink, lilac, mustard, lilac), a large name, a grey role, a hairline divider, "VIEW PROFILE" and a black circle with a white ↗ arrow. Clicking a card flips it 180° on its vertical axis, a perspective rotateY of ~0.5–0.65s. The back is a holographic card: a soft iridescent pastel gradient (cyan, pink, mint-yellow, violet) that drifts with the pointer. It holds "PROFILE / 0n", a round avatar, name and role, location, a one-line bio, "SELECTED PROJECTS" with two ruled rows, "LET'S CONNECT" plus an email, and a QR code with "SCAN ME", with a round flip-back icon at top right. Only one card shows its back at a time: opening the next card flips the open one back to its front in the same moment (Maya at 0–0.5s, Leo at ~0.8–1.45s, Noah at ~1.8–2.4s, Noah back to front ~2.8–3.45s, Leo again ~6.05–6.65s, and so on). Hovering a card tilts it in 3D toward the pointer (up to ~8–10° tilt, the card skews in perspective) and lays the same iridescent shimmer over its front (3.6–5.9s on Noah and Amina). The wire, strings, header and footer never move, and cards that are not hovered or flipping hold still. The footer has two small tracked grey captions: "THE PEOPLE MAKE THE WORK." at left and "HOVER TO SHIMMER · CLICK / TAP TO FLIP" at right.

criteria.check: The page background is a flat near-white (#fcfcfc), with no gradient, texture or panel behind the cards
A small tracked uppercase grey label reads exactly 'OUR STUDIO · THE PEOPLE', preceded by a small violet dot, at top-left around x≈95–265, y≈81
Headline first line reads exactly 'Meet the people' in near-black, ~58px, left edge x≈85, baseline region y≈125–175
Second line 'behind the work.' is the same size as line 1 but coloured soft lavender (~#a597dd), not black and not saturated purple
Top-right grey paragraph reads 'Different minds, shared curiosity. A small' / 'team making thoughtful things together.' over two lines starting at x≈1190, y≈155
Below the paragraph, a green dot then tracked uppercase '04 PEOPLE, ONE TEAM' at y≈225
Bottom-left caption reads 'THE PEOPLE MAKE THE WORK.' (x≈84, y≈925) and bottom-right reads 'HOVER TO SHIMMER · CLICK / TAP TO FLIP' ending x≈1473, both small tracked grey
A thin grey wire spans from x≈247 to x≈1310, ends at y≈303, sagging in a smooth curve to y≈327 near the centre (not a straight line)
Exactly 4 small light-grey round beads sit on the wire, at x≈282, 613, 944, 1275
From each bead a 1px grey hairline drops straight down to its card, lengths ≈55, 118, 76, 133px (cards hang at different heights)
Each string ends in a grey semicircular ring-clip (~24px wide, with a small dot at its centre) that overlaps the card's top edge at its centre
Exactly four portrait cards hang from the wire, left to right Maya Bennett, Leo Carter, Noah Williams, Amina Yusuf
Card tops are staggered: card 1 ≈362, card 2 ≈445, card 3 ≈402, card 4 ≈440; cards 2 and 4 hang lowest, card 1 highest
At rest each card is slightly rotated, not square: card 1 ≈−2° (right side higher), card 2 ≈+1°, card 3 ≈−1°, card 4 ≈+1.5°
Card front is a light grey (#f2f2f2) slab ~300×415 with ~22px corner radius and a soft diffuse drop shadow, with no visible border stroke
Card 4 front top row reads 'PEOPLE · STUDIO' at left and '#04' at right, tiny tracked grey uppercase
Avatar render sits in a rounded square (~250×225, radius ~14) inset ~20px from the card edges, edge-to-edge image with no border
Noah Williams' avatar backdrop is warm mustard (#e4c07a); Maya's is pink, Leo's and Amina's are pale lilac
Card 3 front shows 'Noah Williams' (~26px, dark grey) with 'Product Designer' (~15px, mid grey) under it
Roles read 'Creative Director' (Maya), 'Motion Designer' (Leo), 'Product Designer' (Noah), 'Brand Designer' (Amina)
Under a hairline divider each front shows 'VIEW PROFILE' in tiny tracked dark caps at left and a ~26px solid black circle with a white ↗ arrow at right
Avatars are the clip's own 3D clay-style character busts (magenta-haired woman, dark-quiffed man, curly-haired man in teal tee, black-bob woman with hoop earrings), not flat icons or initials
Exactly one card shows its back at a time: at 2.6s only Noah's card (3rd) is on its holographic back while the other three show fronts
The back is a soft iridescent holographic gradient blending pale cyan, pink, mint-yellow and violet, smoothly blurred like foil sheen
The holographic back has NO hard colour bands, stripes or rainbow lines and no grain; hues fade into each other and the white-grey card base shows through
Back top-left reads 'PROFILE / 03' in tracked small caps; top-right is a ~22px translucent grey circle with a ↰ return glyph
Back shows a ~40px round avatar thumbnail beside 'Noah Williams' with 'Product Designer' under it, then '⌖ New York, US'
Bio reads 'Designing small details that make the big picture work.' wrapping to two lines
'SELECTED PROJECTS' caption followed by 2 ruled rows 'Product / Atlas' and 'System / Mono', each separated by a hairline
Bottom-left reads 'LET'S CONNECT' (tracked caps) above 'noah@example.com'
Bottom-right of the back has a ~60px black-on-white QR code pattern with three finder squares and the caption 'SCAN ME' below it

Leo's back reads 'PROFILE / 02', 'Leo Carter', 'Motion Designer', 'Berlin, DE', 'Making everyday interactions feel a little more alive.', projects 'Motion / Orbit' and 'Launch / Loop', email 'leo@example.com'
Maya's back reads 'PROFILE / 01', 'London, UK', 'Turning interesting ideas into things people remember.', projects 'Identity / Forma' and 'Campaign / Light', 'maya@example.com'
Card 1 turns on its vertical axis in perspective: at 0.15s it is seen edge-on as a narrow skewed sliver (~95px wide), and by 0.65s it is fully open, ~305px wide, showing its back
Between 0.65s and 1.13s Maya's card flips from back to front while Leo's card flips from front to back in the same span (~0.6s), so still only one back shows
Between 1.13s and 2.6s Leo returns to front and Noah's card turns to its back; at 1.98s Leo's card is visibly foreshortened mid-turn (narrower, ~245px)
Mid-flip the card shows real 3D perspective: the near vertical edge is taller than the far edge (trapezoid), not a flat horizontal squash
During a flip the card stays hung from its clip: the clip and string stay at the same x and the card turns about its own vertical centre line, with no slide sideways

Hovering a front card (Noah, Amina at ~4.75s) lays the iridescent pastel sheen over its grey front and tilts it in 3D toward the pointer, about 5–10°, so the card reads as a skewed quad. At 2.6s the same fronts are flat grey
While the pointer moves over an open back, that card's tilt and sheen shift with it (Leo's card at 7.0s leans left/top, unlike its pose at 6.6s) and nothing else moves
Cards that are neither hovered nor flipping hold perfectly still. They do not sway, bob or swing between 0.5s and 0.75s: Noah's and Amina's cards are pixel-identical
Wire, beads, strings, headline, paragraph and footer captions never move across the whole clip
Flipping continues through the clip: by ~6.6s Leo's card is on its back again, and later Amina's card (4th) is also shown on its back ('PROFILE / 04'), always one back at a time
